sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks' row 18 (check #17) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 18 (identical wording; no extra annotation columns or cell comments on this row); sheet list and the 53-row count

rules/projects/webdev-task-template: instruction.md, solution/solve.sh, solution/app/server.js, environment/instructions/integration.md, environment/instructions/notes.md, tests/app_context.md (remaining template files were listed but not opened; not relevant to this row)
task/solution/app/src/index.js, change-sets.js, rules.js, db.js, bootstrap.js (whole files)
task/solution/app/public/js/app.js, change-sets.js, hireops.js (whole files); public/styles.css NOT read
evidence: Walked instruction.md and the /instructions notes line by line against solution/app (source read; no container started). SCREENS: all six asked-for views exist - solution/app/public/js/app.js:13-20 WORKSPACES (Coordinated Changes, Requisitions, Offers, Equity Table, Referrals, Audit Trail); pages built in public/js/hireops.js:84 (requisitions), :257 (offers), :270 (equity), :315 (referrals), :400 (audit) and public/js/change-sets.js:39. No dashboard or theme switch, as the brief allows. ROLES/ACCOUNTS: seven seeded users with Hireops!2026 (src/db.js:126,138-140); session-only identity and 401/403 (src/index.js:84-103); raise = recruiter/comp partner/approver/finance (index.js:330); approve = approver with dual control, tier check and run-rate budget gate (index.js:350-357); revise = recruiter/approver/finance (index.js:373); rescind = finance with a required effective date (index.js:406-408); requisition creation for any signed-in role including Recruiter (index.js:318; form hireops.js:64-82). OFFER DESK: exact integer composition - intrinsic, annualized, run-rate, band basis (src/rules.js:62-99) - all shown on the offer card (hireops.js:136-146); approval mints commitment, grant, signing remittance and referral accrual in one transaction (index.js:352-369); revision supersedes, reverses and recommits, posts the signed signing adjustment and replaces the grant (index.js:375-399); rescission releases, claws back unvested signing and cancels unvested units from the supplied effective date (index.js:409-424; rules.js:105-139; calendar months rules.js:31-48); headroom netted from movement rows with the movements listed (rules.js:154-163; hireops.js:52-60); payments, adjustments and net total across the lineage (rules.js:168-182; hireops.js:164-165); referral halves, hire start and cliff against the reference moment (rules.js:142-151; hireops.js:301-312); append-only audit lines and before/after after-images (index.js:296-307, 436-444; hireops.js:384-419). Revision and rescission drawer forms keep entered values and show the refusal on failure (app.js:194-206; rescind effective-date field hireops.js:195-200). COORDINATED CHANGE (rules s.11): 2-4 distinct members, operation key per actor, same-intent replay and 409 on changed intent (src/change-sets.js:40-58, 99-115); whole-set netting so fully committed cycles fit (change-sets.js:60-86); ABA-safe staleness via per-requisition MAX(commitment_movements.id) plus a source-currency test (change-sets.js:13-16, 122-125); atomic commit with successor on the destination requisition, reversal plus commitment, signing delta, grant replacement and no second referral (change-sets.js:117-163); a committed retry returns the stored receipt without revalidation after the owner/session check (change-sets.js:119-120); receipt persisted in SQLite so it survives restart (change-sets.js:8-11, 160). Lost-response notice and 'Retry this same operation' control (public/js/change-sets.js:326-339). CHANGE DESK (rules s.12): per-member old/new run-rate, signing adjustment, old/new band basis and per-requisition before/after headroom with an 'Over budget by' warning, all computed before saving (public/js/change-sets.js:184-252); add up to four, remove any member while more than two remain, others untouched (:102-163); refusal names member and field, sets aria-invalid and moves focus to the explanation (:210-215, 255-289); focus to the saved preview (:292-294); live updates by SSE on every successful write, patched in place without rebuilding the editor (src/index.js:42-50, 215-220; app.js:249-264, 282-316; change-sets.js:354-395); saved previews marked Current / Out of date using the same server test commit applies (src/change-sets.js:19-36; public :303-307); a change committed elsewhere shows COMMITTED with its receipt; a stale selected offer is flagged on its own row (:220, 226); unsent entries and operation key kept in localStorage keyed by user id, surviving view switch, reload and session loss and invisible to another user (:32, 66-77, 380-382; app.js:38-49, 326-333); what-if editor for every role, with save/commit offered only to Finance and a server 403 otherwise (:31, 50-53; src/change-sets.js:99, 116). RUNTIME: node /app/server.js -> src/index.js -> bootstrap; listener on PORT||3000 at 0.0.0.0 with /api/health answered before any database work (src/bootstrap.js:18-24, 43); UI and API from one process; DB_PATH honoured, default resolved from the module directory to /app/app.db (src/db.js:13); bundled seed copy is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 1b390154...); seeds once (db.js:122-124); solve.sh ships no database; only express and better-sqlite3 are required. MEASURED SUPPORT (verified by me; not a judge or Oracle run): raw-evidence-index.json lists 10 artifacts; I recomputed every artifact sha256 and all 14 matching solution source hashes against the frozen task and all match. results/live-desk.json records 11/11 scripted golden browser observations passed with no page errors (live figures, out-of-date arrival 807 ms with typing/focus/scroll kept, middle-member removal, field-level refusal, entries across reload and session loss, auditor what-if, lost-response retry, restart); regression/batch-domain-attempt2/results.json 15/15 and regression/repair-coverage/results.json 3/3 through the API. LIMITS: the index itself states the golden has not been scripted through every Functional criterion and no full configured judge run exists; the approve/rescind UI paths and the Equity, Referrals and Audit pages were confirmed here by source reading, not by a browser run in this round. That gap belongs to row 18 and the runtime-evidence records; this row asks whether the reference plausibly implements each asked-for capability, and I found none missing. Minor non-blocking observations: the requisition-creation form is also offered to the Auditor (rules s.1 permits other roles as optional intake, though it sits beside 'the auditor changes nothing at all'); CLAWBACK_CONTRA remittance rows display a positive amount under their kind label while the lineage net subtracts them. Probe: a reference lacking live updates, per-user unsent entries or what-if for non-Finance roles would leave a brief line unimplemented - each is present; the golden's SSE and localStorage choices are not imposed on alternatives because rules s.12 leaves mechanism open.
